notes: Retired the universal Mods system from active FEHA play. Legacy Mod items are no longer part of the catalog/economy.
On GM load, FEHA creates and verifies a hidden world backup of all legacy Mod world items, owned Mod items, and 07 — MODS folders before deleting them from Foundry.
The 07 — MODS folder tree and its manufacturer subfolders are removed after their contents are backed up; player-owned legacy Mods are removed as well.
Existing Market stock references to retired Mod item IDs are removed and the Market is refreshed.

Legacy modSlots metadata and visible Mod Slots rows are stripped from remaining world and owned gear so weapons, armor, and cyberware no longer advertise a universal socket system. Bespoke item customization remains a GM/player-specific future option rather than a catalog mechanic.
